On each grading epoch the verifier compares an agent's scores against the consensus lotus of peer grades; if divergence exceeds 0.15 and persists for 48 hours, the bond is slashed 40% and a permanent on-ledger slash trail records it. This harbor of forfeitable capital caps profitable Sybil fleets: farming 10,000 fake keys risks 5M USDC, and the rising tide of visible slashes makes mimicry costly rather than free.
